notes.title: Fishing Adventure: Finland Reserve is now open for fishing!
notes.content:
Hello, Anglers!

The world of fishing just expanded its horizons! Dive into the chilly waters of Finland with the latest DLC, "Fishing Adventure: Finland Reserve." If you've ever dreamt of fishing in pristine Nordic waters, this is your golden ticket.

Embark on a journey with exciting features:

[list][*] [b]The Beauty of Finland's Lakes:[/b] Experience fishing in one of Finland's most mesmerizing lakes, known for its crystal-clear waters and teeming aquatic life.
[*] [b]Diverse Aquatic Life: [/b]Challenge your angling prowess against perch, zander, pike, salmon, and the elusive brown trout. Every catch promises a tale of its own.
[*] [b]Explore Hidden Gems:[/b] Navigate the intricate waterways, unraveling secrets with every cast. From secluded coves to vast open waters, the adventure never ceases.
[*] [b]More than Just Fishing:[/b] While the thrill of the catch is unbeatable, this DLC offers an experience beyond fishing. Immerse yourself in the picturesque landscapes of Finland, from rugged coastlines to serene lakeside views.[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2270730/Fishing_Adventure_Finland_Reserve/

Your next fishing tale awaits in the heart of Finland. Grab your fishing gear, set out on an expedition, and let the breathtaking beauty of Finland be your backdrop.

Now available for all Fishing Adventure players. Experience Finland, one cast at a time! 🐟

notes.title: Join Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2 BETA TESTS!
notes.content:
[h3]GOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOD morning Anglers! [/h3]

As you may notice or maybe you didn't - Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2 is getting closer to the release with every day! That is why we just announced the Steam Playtest for UFS2 (Steam beta test future).

So if you would like to take part in beta tests just press the button visible on the main page! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136380/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator_2][b]CLICK HERE[/b][/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1136380/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator_2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36994199/95b2b35f0de9eb5daf8bda3101dbfd234bfc08c7.png[/img][/url]

Also, everyone who will take part in the beta-test and will fill the survey will be able to win one of the below prizes!

[list][*] 30x Ultimate Fishing Simulator 2 (Steam Key on Release)
[*] 10x Ultimate Fishing Simulator Complete Edition (Steam Key)[/list]

[h1]When does it start?[/h1]
Playtest will be run somewhere in February (or the end of January). In general, you will be able to opt-in for at least 2 months. 

We want to make sure that the game we develop was done properly. We won’t be able to satisfy everyone but we will do our best to listen to the community and do regular surveys about future updates.

That's all for today! Take care, everyone!

- Rafal

Read the latest News:

notes.title: VR version & DLC are now available on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33265723/01182d0057b16d9c756fd8f044f42a2936ba147e.jpg[/img]

Dear Fellow Virtual Anglers,
today we are giving you another extension of our game. VR support was one of the first things you asked for, and the topic with VR support requests had several pages.

From the beginning of this great game, we've been trying to listen to your feedback and make the changes you asked for. So it happened this time ... it only took us a little more time.

[h1]Here they are, with players in mind we have created VR both as a separate product:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1024010/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator_VR/

[h1]and as a DLC for current owners of the classic version:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137540/Ultimate_Fishing_Simulator__VR_DLC

[h1][b]EARLY BETA ACCESS for VR and VR DLC[/b][/h1]
This is our first contact with VR and it requires a lot of work from us. In order to enable playing the VR version as many people as possible, we want to introduce compatibility with the most popular VR headsets and controllers.

Due to implementing VR, we discovered that the game engine used in the basic version of the game needs to be updated and many game functions will need to be rewritten.

We also want to make as many gameplay features as possible playable with VR controllers, as well as create UI that's comfortable to use in VR. 

This will take some time and this why we want to let you know that this DLC will be updated for the next 1 to 2 months.

So...I hope you will enjoy VR version of this great game and will help us to make it even better!

[i]Kind Regards,
Rafał - Project Manager in Ultimate Games S.A.[/i]
